// PROBE — must stay GREEN under tests/unit/attention-areas.test.ts.
// Speaks only the closed vocabulary, and carries every near-miss shape the
// scanner must NOT read as an alignment word.
export function paint(area: { alignment: string }) {
    const labels = { alignmentCta: "uncovered", textAlignment: "center" }
    // alignment: "unprotected"  ← a comment is not a production
    const row = { id: "household", alignment: "gap" }
    if (area.alignment === "appears_covered") return labels.alignmentCta
    if (area.alignment !== "not_yet_checked") return labels.textAlignment
    let verdict = "review"
    verdict = "unknown"
    return row.alignment + verdict
}
